steps.title: Plate
actions: File > New > Standard (mm).ipt and save it as bottom_cover.ipt.
Sketch a circle diameter 180 on the XZ Plane. Extrude 2 mm. Fillet the bottom edge 1.5.

steps.title: Locating rim and pod socket
actions: Sketch circles diameter 172 and 175.8, and 70 and 74. Extrude 4 mm, Join.
steps.note: The rim locates the cover inside the chassis wall; the control pod stands in the socket.

steps.title: Battery door openings
actions: Sketch an 18 x 42 rectangle 58 mm right of the centre. Extrude Cut Through All. Mirror it to the left.

steps.title: Door screw bosses
actions: Sketch circles diameter 5 at x 67, y 27.5. Extrude 4 mm, Join; Mirror twice.
Hole diameter 2.2 up through each boss (for the security screws).

steps.title: Cover screw holes
actions: Hole: countersunk 6 x 90 degrees, diameter 2.5, Through All, at radius 60 on 45 degrees; Circular Pattern 4. Save.
steps.note: The screws go up into the bosses under the deck of the chassis.
